scope: Independent CPU review with Model.cuda explicitly disabled. No planner/optimizer or GPU collision calls.

resolved_finding.issue: Direct evaluate(InitializeAutoDiff(q)) receives a 7x1 column and previously misidentified its entries as non-AutoDiff arrays, raising TypeError in the recovery path.
resolved_finding.repair: Adapter now validates vector/column shape, flattens while preserving AutoDiff values, and checks finite value/derivative inputs.

official_source_checks.finding: Known BoxBoxGradient witness-point assertion matches this real Kinova failure.
Open upstream candidate repair at review time; this local adapter does not claim that the official patch is installed.
Original aggregation max_num_values is the complete GetCollisionCandidates size; the adapter preserves this cardinality and every canonical pair.
Native aggregate filters at influence distance, pads with zero penalties to max_num_values, and uses its native smooth-over-max; returning every pair to that same aggregate preserves these semantics.

rejection_checks: Unknown RuntimeError and SystemExit propagate without fallback
Known assertion on non-box geometry rejected

limits: Independent tests exercise the recorded failure and adversarial inputs. Finite-difference recovery is a numerical adapter at near contact, not a symbolic differentiability or continuous-collision proof.
